profile.description: Colorado River Indian Tribes Recreation / SDP-REC relationship. Robin Howard made an inbound pricing inquiry in June 2026 and remains listed as Recreation Coordinator.

notes.subject: Inbound pricing inquiry requires history check
notes.body: On June 4, 2026 Robin Howard asked for pricing for all units, setup/breakdown and any other invoice costs. Current CRIT Recreation information still identifies Robin as Coordinator. Before replying, check whether a later ACT/phone interaction already resolved the inquiry; if none exists, treat this as an unanswered inbound buying inquiry rather than cold outreach.

followUps.label: Resolve CRIT pricing inquiry
followUps.reason: Check later phone/ACT history after June 4 first. If nobody answered Robin, respond with current package pricing and legitimate setup/tear-down costs and verify the event date/logistics.
